mechanisms.quote: Optimized by removing redundant imports, dead code, pre-computing ratios, and reordering `isinstance` checks.
Introduced a `get_label_dict()` cache on `UserAPIKeyLabelValues` to avoid redundant `model_dump()` calls
converted `supported_enum_labels` to a `frozenset` for O(1) lookups
Optimized header lookup to use an early-exit loop instead of a full dictionary comprehension.
Replaced `json.dumps` with `orjson.dumps` for improved serialization performance.
Optimized Pydantic `__getattr__` access to handle dict and object annotation types more efficiently.
Add _parse_url() with LRU cache (maxsize=64) that pre-parses URL strings into httpx.URL objects.
The changes focus on reducing GIL contention and synchronous overhead in critical paths.
mechanisms.other_description: Reduces Python GIL contention (lock held by the interpreter) on hot paths; no listed id covers GIL reduction specifically.
